title: Equal end gears on an orbiting idler train
question: Drive B CW. Determine the motion of C (spin) and H (orbit) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive B CW. External mesh A/B (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. External mesh B/C (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. B positive, C held. A is locked to the frame. A held. 34 × (A − H) + 34 × (B − H) = 0. 34 × (B − H) + 34 × (C − H) = 0. The requested motion is stationary / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: B
options.explanation: C must be stationary. External mesh B/C (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. B positive, C held.. H must be CW. External mesh A/B (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. External mesh B/C (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. B positive, C held..

options.label: C
options.explanation: C must be stationary. External mesh B/C (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. B positive, C held..

options.label: D
options.explanation: H must be CW. External mesh A/B (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. A held, B positive. External mesh B/C (34/34 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. B positive, C held..
